column1: # .zap/rules.tsv: seeded by slopstopper install.sh.
# OWASP ZAP rule overrides for the DAST scan. Two common false positives
# for content-heavy sites ship commented-out below. Uncomment ONLY the
# rules that apply to your site, and keep the `# why` line so the
# exception is documented at the point of suppression.
# Format: <rule>\tIGNORE\t# why this is accepted on this site
# <rule> is a plugin id (10055: every alert that plugin raises) or an
# alert ref (10055-13: just that one). Prefer the alert ref; some plugins
# bundle unrelated alerts. See https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/.
# Static host with a <meta> CSP? docs/security/DAST.md lists the three
# header-only alerts to accept.
# Honoured by slopstopper's dast:analyze task AND by the DAST gate
# (cli/slopstopper/dast_gate.py), which names the entry behind each
# finding it swallows.

column1: #                # PHP, JSP, ASP, Java, Python, Ruby): apic.sh is static files

#                # next line (#49, #63), and the docs quote code in every
#                # language on purpose.
